_doc: Human calls on Tours To You show pages (BRO-4931): what a page is when the tour-page-class.js rules cannot or must not decide. Shape: { "<slug>": { class: production|event|aggregator|template|company, title?, type?, parentId?, companyOf?, reason, issue: "BRO-N", reviewedAt } }. An override always wins over every rule. A production with no parentId is a standalone touring show and needs title and type (musical|play|special|opera). An event, aggregator, template or company page is never read by running-tour discovery.

holiday-shows.reason: Lists many different holiday shows on one page (21 cities with an engagement at the same moment on 2026-10-09), not one tour.
